qa_pairs.question: From 2020 to 2024, is the change trend of Chow Tai Fook's operating revenue consistent with the change trend of the turnover proportion of its gold jewelry products? Answer yes or no.
qa_pairs.explanation: From 2020 to 2024, Chow Tai Fook's operating revenue continued to rise (from 51.85 billion yuan to 98.55 billion yuan), and at the same time, the proportion of gold jewelry also increased from 60.9% in 2020 to 80.1% in 2023. qa_pairs.question: Between 2021 and 2023, did Chow Tai Fook's net profit attributable to the parent company deviate from its operating revenue in terms of trends? Answer yes or no.
